sources.kind: official Ministry of Defence history page
sources.title: Le decorazioni al valor militare
sources.evidence_summary: Traces the 1793 predecessor, the interruption/reorganization after 1815, and restoration of gold and silver Military Valour Medals by the 26 March 1833 Royal Warrant. Also distinguishes the medal classes and the Cross for Military Valour family.
supports: keeping the Cross for Military Valour distinct from the medal

sources.title: Regio Decreto 8 dicembre 1887, n. 5100
sources.evidence_summary: The decree title identifies the creation of the bronze Military Valour Medal. The transcription is used for the decree/date clue; it is not represented as an original Gazette scan.

sources.kind: official Presidency of the Republic honours page
sources.title: Medaglia al Valor Civile
sources.evidence_summary: Attributes the 30 April 1851 R.D. no.1168 to Victor Emmanuel II and lists gold, silver, and bronze degrees; the source is the current official institutional record for the award history.
supports: IT-KOI-003 family, institution date, and grades

sources.kind: official Ministry of Defence historical legislation index
sources.title: Repertorio storico — 1910–1920
sources.evidence_summary: Index entry: 19 January 1918, Royal Decree no.205, institution of a War Merit Cross; notes official-gazette publication.
supports: IT-KOI-004 institution date and legal identifier

sources.title: Regio Decreto 10 marzo 1918, n. 356
sources.evidence_summary: Amends provisions of R.D. 19 January 1918 no.205, including the War Merit Cross rules; supports distinguishing this cross from the Military Valour Cross.
supports: IT-KOI-004 legal chronology and distinction from the Cross for Military Valour
